summary: Iter46 P5 refactor regression — PASS. The extraction of attendance endpoints into /app/backend/routers/attendance.py and shared primitives into /app/backend/deps.py did not break anything. Backend: 25/25 tests PASS covering all 9 attendance endpoints (shape + RBAC), 3 business PATCH endpoints (admin-only), and 9 non-attendance server.py endpoints (login x5 roles, /api/auth/me, /api/products, /api/public/products, /api/orders, /api/customers, /api/business, /api/public/site, /api/public/business). Frontend: 5/5 scenarios PASS — admin dashboard loads with topbar-punch visible; /console/presence shows stats-table + CSV + PDF export buttons; /console/parametres?tab=pointage shows 6/6 toggles checked and pointage-save button; sales login shows RBAC-filtered sidebar (no Finances, no Produits); rider1 login lands on /rider with rider-punch-btn visible. RBAC enforced: sales & cm get 403 on /api/attendance/today and /api/attendance/all-stats; manager & sales get 403 on PATCH /api/business/attendance-config. attendance_config left in {enabled:true, enabled_roles:[manager,sales,stock_keeper,community_manager,rider]} as requested.
critical_code_review_comments: deps.py cleanly isolates the single Motor client, bcrypt helpers, JWT helpers and the auth dependencies — good foundation for further router extractions.

routers/attendance.py uses `prefix='/api'` on its own APIRouter and is included with `app.include_router(attendance_router)` AFTER `app.include_router(api)` — ordering is fine because paths don't collide.
server.py still imports `AsyncIOMotorClient`, `bcrypt`, `jwt` at module level even though they are re-exported from deps. Non-blocking but a future cleanup could drop those unused top-level imports.
Note: original problem statement claimed endpoint '/api/me' but the actual endpoint is '/api/auth/me'. Updated test accordingly; no code bug.
deps.require_role grants implicit access to 'admin' regardless of listed roles — preserved from monolith, correct behavior.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. The test_check_in_with_selfie creates/updates manager attendance for today, but attendance_config left as {enabled:true, enabled_roles:[manager,sales,stock_keeper,community_manager,rider]} as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P5 refactor baseline (deps.py + routers/attendance.py) is stable. For future router extractions, the pattern app.include_router(api) followed by app.include_router(<new_router>) works. Use /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_refactor_regression.py as a regression smoke for subsequent slices. Note the real auth endpoint is /api/auth/me (not /api/me).
